description: This file declares the 'Request' class within the WebSockets::JsonRpc namespace, which is related to handling JSON-RPC request messages over WebSockets. It includes methods for creating requests, retrieving IDs, and converting requests to strings, as well as managing request IDs with an atomic counter.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: Represents a JSON-RPC request message for WebSockets communication implementing methods for creation, ID retrieval, string representation, and ID generation.

methods.name: create(std::string method, const JsonObject &parameters)
methods.description: Creates a JSON-RPC request with the specified method and parameters.

methods.name: getId() const
methods.description: Returns the ID of the request.

methods.name: toString() const
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the request.

methods.name: generateId()
methods.description: Generates a unique request ID using an atomic counter.
